summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship pipeline for cipher-box Phase 68 (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit CLI → ship → resolve PR reviews) without babysitting, per the GSD ship-phase playbook.
summary.outcome: Phase 68 was secured (0 open threats), validated (0 Nyquist gaps), simplified (real bug fix + dead code removal), passed the SDK E2E gate after fixing two environment issues, cleared 19 in-scope CodeRabbit findings across two review rounds, had learnings extracted (8/7/8/7), and was shipped as PR #587 with STATE.md updated; final PR-review resolution and merge were left for after the transcript ends.

repo: The local API's TEE_WORKER_URL defaults to :3001, which is actually the mock-ipns-routing service port; the real tee-worker runs on :3002 — misconfiguration silently breaks TEE-touching SDK E2E tests without an obvious error.

Local docker containers for services like tee-worker can silently run a stale pre-phase image; SDK E2E failures after a code change may require rebuilding the container from current source, not just the app code.

apps/api does not log handled 4xx responses — diagnosing a real 400 requires temporarily adding an axios response interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts to log err.response.data, then reverting.

apps/web/src/services/ipns.service.test.ts fails even on main (pre-existing, unrelated to phase changes) and apps/web's vitest suite is not wired into any CI job at all — both worth fixing but non-blocking for now.

GSD conventional-commit rule allows scoped parens like `feat(scope):` — only the description part must be paren-free; a branch with 86 commits already satisfied this, making the filter-branch reword step a no-op.

gsd-secure-phase and gsd-validate-phase workflows can short-circuit to writing SECURITY.md/VALIDATION.md directly without spawning their auditor subagents when threats_open:0 with a plan-time register at ASVS level 1, or when no gaps are found respectively — letting the orchestrator do the audit inline.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed a parent readKey before the children loop finished unsealing with it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — real bug caught by the simplify pass and fixed with a red-green-verified regression test.
Contained dead functions (including ensureFreshSentShares) and an unused exported constant orphaned by the rotation cutover; removed after confirming zero external importers.

updateGrant lacked a monotonic anti-rollback guard on rootGeneration; added per CodeRabbit finding, with new spec coverage in shares.service.spec.ts, later revised again to a transaction-based flow in the re-review round.

workflow: Running independent long steps (security audit, simplify review, SDK E2E gate build) as concurrent background jobs while the orchestrator continues other prep work (PR body drafting, branch/gh checks) kept the pipeline moving without idle waiting.

CodeRabbit CLI findings converged from 28 → 2 → 0 in-scope across two review rounds by fixing in-scope items immediately and deferring pre-existing/out-of-domain ones to todos — matching the operating rule's triage instruction.
Deferred/out-of-scope findings were captured as dated markdown files under .planning/todos/pending/ with file refs, keeping the phase branch unblocked while preserving a paper trail.

For a stubborn, seemingly-unrelated test failure (ipns.service.test.ts), a decisive isolation experiment — swapping in main's version of the file and re-running — was used to confirm the failure was pre-existing rather than caused by the phase's changes.

friction: SDK E2E gate failed on first two runs due to environment drift (stale tee-worker container image, wrong TEE_WORKER_URL port pointing at mock-ipns-routing instead of the real worker) rather than actual code regressions, costing significant investigation time before the fix was found.

Diagnosing the ipns.service.test.ts vitest failure required an extensive detour (diffing against main, tracing import chains, checking API client and vitest config changes) before concluding it was pre-existing and out of scope.
The gsd-tools shim initialization boilerplate embedded in every workflow skill invocation is extremely long and repeated across secure-phase, validate-phase, extract-learnings, and ship workflows.
CodeRabbit's PR-level review required a second full re-run after the first round of fixes, adding another triage cycle before the branch was clean.
